vates.description: Stock-pair oracle for Robinhood Chain (4663): implied USD price, pool depth, price impact from an on-chain quoter, deviation vs Chainlink, whether the underlying market is open, and upcoming corporate actions. Uniswap v4 AND v3 — v3 carries roughly a third of stock-paired volume. Deterministic; no model in the data path.

route.description: Which oracle route to call. Defaults to /quote.

pool.description: /quote only: a Uniswap v4 poolId (32 bytes) or a v3 pool address. Get one from route=/pools.

size.description: /quote only: trade size in whole tokens of the paired side; adds a quoter-simulated price impact.

symbol.description: /price, /pools: stock ticker as listed on chain 4663, e.g. NVDA.

withinDays.description: /corporate-actions only: how far ahead to look. Defaults to 30.

question.description: /ask only (POST): free-text question. The answer carries the facts behind it and a call that reproduces it.

protocol.description: /quote: v4 or v3 — which protocol the pool belongs to.

price.description: /quote: spot as currency1 per currency0, and the implied USD price of the paired token where a Chainlink feed exists.

depth.description: /quote: ACTIVE-TICK ESTIMATE of pool depth. It can mislead; size a trade on impact instead.

impact.description: /quote with size: amountOut, executionPrice, priceImpact and gasEstimate from an on-chain quoter simulation. `source` names the quoter (quoter for v4, quoter-v3 for v3).

oracle.description: /quote: Chainlink feed read, deviation, and deviationReason. deviation: null is normal and NEVER means zero — 159 of 194 stock tokens have no feed, so a deviation is unknowable rather than absent.

corporateAction.description: /quote: the pricing asset's current and pending ERC-8056 UI multiplier, and when a pending one takes effect.

market.description: /quote: whether the underlying equity market is open, from an exchange calendar rather than a feed.

pools.description: /pools: the top pool identifiers for a stock, ordered by measured 24h swaps, each with the /quote call that prices it. swaps24h: null means never measured, not measured at zero.

answer.description: /ask: the answer text, alongside `facts` (every number it cites) and `reproduce` (a different route returning the same figure).
